# Abelard

*1079 – 1142 · French · [Scholasticism](../movements/scholasticism.md)*

French logician and theologian, a master in the schools of Paris: his Sic et non sets contradictory authorities side by side and fixed the method of [scholasticism](../movements/scholasticism.md); his correspondence with Heloise remains famous.
